data.body: Plan review 2026-11-22 22:03 PST (sandboxed, api.anthropic.com allowed): BLOCK on G1G2 - infra/gerrit/service-user.sh (the token create/rotate tool) puts the token in ssh/aws/awk argv and was not classified. Response: survey and split written into the description. This ticket keeps the production review-bot fix (src/rebar); operator tooling, the workflow and the docs moved to immoral-heated-doctorfish (filed, discovered_from), which also owns service-user.sh. The rotation decision should follow doctorfish's service-user.sh fix. Acceptance criteria unchanged. Separately, the first sandboxed review at 21:44 was INDETERMINATE because that command did not list api.anthropic.com for the sandbox proxy (sub-exceptions: httpx.ProxyError 403 'not in allowed_domains'); the classifier called it a transient blip - filed vinyl-dubnium-squamata.
